# Graft project — agent guide (Astro blog)

Everything is code. Content lives in MDX files; git is authoritative; the
content index is derived. If they disagree, git wins — recompile.

- Schema: graft.config.ts (`posts` collection). The single source of truth.
- Documents: content/posts/<slug>.mdx — frontmatter must satisfy the collection schema.
- Images: site-root paths under public/blog/<slug>/ (not Sanity CDN, not S3).
- Slugs are kebab-case; a frontmatter `slug:` overrides the filename.
- Project into the index: `graft compile` (one-shot) or `graft dev` (watch mode).
- This project uses the **static index** (`index = "static"` in graft.config):
  compile writes .graft/index.db — a SQLite artifact. No database, no env vars.
- The artifact is derived, so it is git-ignored. Dev and Vercel build run
  `graft compile && astro build` (see package.json).
- Read it from the app with `getGraft()` in src/lib/graft.ts.
- Bodies render through Astro content collections + `@astrojs/mdx` (no MdxBody).
- One-time Sanity export: `bun run export:sanity` (needs PUBLIC_SANITY_* env).
- Branches here are just **git branches**: each checkout compiles its own artifact.
- Studio, operational data, typed functions, and database branching need the
  Postgres tier. Adding one fails with NEEDS_DATABASE.
- Primitives: `graft add <item>` lands under graft/. Run `graft add` to list.
- Every Graft error carries a `fix` — do what it says, then retry.
